Subject: Request for strict M6b Gate A local Compustat PIT-family export/source-access approval

Hello,

Please do not send credentials, passwords, tokens, connection strings, provider output, data extracts by email, or API instructions.

For a local-only strict research-data verification workflow, please confirm whether you can approve a human-owned local export from the licensed S&P Compustat PIT family for the approved M6b issuer-quarter universe. This request binds the successor Gate A semantic contract at docs/authorization/V2_PEAD_M6B_GATE_A_EPS_DEFINITION_CONTRACT_REQUEST_20260701.json, SHA-256 27a065e5a37d44acd5e423e448d0a894274b48215eb0bcfc32968d5ba5931063.

As part of approval, please provide a non-secret source-capability attestation identifying the exact entitled fields and licensed dictionary definitions for first-public identity, revision/original/restated or source-update status, minute-or-finer release timestamp capability, unambiguous timezone, issuer-quarter identity, and date-ranged mapping. If the selected PIT record lacks complete eligible timing, please name a separately authorized immutable timing artifact and a deterministic one-to-one join.

Please also bind an immutable market-calendar artifact with source identity, license/owner attestation, exchange timezone, version/export provenance, path, SHA-256, coverage, is_trading_session, scheduled_close_local, holiday schedule, and early-close schedule.

Please confirm the exact currently entitled tables/views and field names from the licensed dictionary, approved outside-Git local artifact paths, source-as-of/export timestamps, and permission for an agent to inspect only named local bytes after human export.

This request is source-access approval only. It does not authorize agent login, credentials, provider/API access, downloads, extraction, data generation, factual Gate A validation, or strict readiness.

Thank you.
